findings.problem: parse::<u32>().unwrap() panics when a line cannot be parsed as u32
findings.failure_mode: any non-numeric or out-of-range line in the input causes an abort instead of a typed error; untrusted input can crash the process
findings.fix: replace unwrap with a fallible parse that returns a Result<Vec<u32>, ParseError> or collects only valid values with explicit error reporting

findings.problem: production-reachable code contains unwrap(), a panic path forbidden in non-test/non-bench production code
findings.failure_mode: parse failure triggers panic instead of a typed error, making the function unsuitable for safety-critical or untrusted-input paths
findings.fix: return Result<Vec<u32>, E> or use a filter_map that collects only valid parses with explicit error aggregation

findings.problem: Result from parse::<u32>() is ignored; parse failure silently skips the line or panics via unwrap
findings.failure_mode: callers cannot distinguish between a valid 0-entry parse and a parse that failed on every line; error information is discarded
findings.fix: return a Result or collect failures into an error aggregate so callers can inspect what went wrong

findings.problem: no benchmark, profiler, or latency/throughput evidence exists for this parser; the claim that it is 'unbounded' is stated but unproven
findings.failure_mode: without measurement, there is no evidence that this parser meets any performance budget, and the unbounded iterator over lines() could process arbitrarily large inputs without backpressure
findings.fix: provide benchmark evidence, state the input size bound, and declare the allocation budget (Vec<u32> grows with input size)

findings.problem: Vec<u32> returned by collect() grows with input size; no try_reserve, max size declaration, or graceful allocation failure handling is present
findings.failure_mode: arbitrarily large input causes unbounded heap allocation without any preallocation hint or growth bound, risking OOM on untrusted input
findings.fix: either declare a max input size and call try_reserve, or stream-parse without materializing the full Vec

missing_evidence: no assembly/IR evidence for the hot path
no latency or throughput target stated
residual_risk: static review only; no cargo commands were run
